visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler boy wearing a grey shark costume with a white-toothed hood stands in a domestic indoor setting. He mimics a clawing action with his hands while looking at the camera, smiling in front of a white tiled wall and a green door. (2) The scene transitions to the entrance of 'Wanpi World Zoo'. The boy, still in his shark costume, walks down a wide paved path towards a large red-lattice gate. Parked cars are visible on the left, and a few tourists are scattered in the background. (3) A man in a white lab coat is shown leaning into a small white three-wheeled electric cart parked on a red-brick walkway. He places a smartphone on the driver's seat. The background is lush with green grass and trees under a cloudy sky. (4) A selfie-perspective shot shows a man in a black face mask and black graphic t-shirt driving the electric cart with the boy sitting behind him. They travel down a paved zoo path lined with trees and floral displays. (5) The man and the boy walk away from the camera, holding hands. The boy is now dressed in a grey t-shirt and dark shorts. They approach a red wooden building with a sign that reads 'African Animal House'. (6) A series of quick cuts shows the boy observing a serval cat through a glass enclosure, a train of capybara-themed carts carrying visitors, and a camel chewing in its outdoor pen. (7) Finally, the boy sits in a pink toy train ride with cartoon features. He holds the steering wheel with a joyful expression. A carousel and several park benches are visible in the background under bright daylight.

There is no background music at first. (2) A bright, upbeat pop instrumental BGM fades in, featuring a synthesized melody and a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. The tempo is approximately 124 BPM. The music is dominant, while the room tone is very clean. (3) As the video transitions outdoors, a faint layer of nature and outdoor ambient noise is integrated into the mix, though the BGM remains the primary signal. The music maintains a consistent major key and energetic vibe. (4) The narrator's voice reappears briefly toward the end, commenting with rising intonations as he speaks to the child. The BGM and vocals overlap cleanly with a high signal-to-noise ratio. (5) The track concludes with the music maintaining its rhythm through the final shots of the toy ride, ending with a standard fade-out.
